Subject: SOC2 compliance walkthrough — unattended session & next steps

Hi Liza / MedNova security team,

I logged into our scheduled SOC2 walkthrough at 9:00 AM PST but it looks like no one joined from your side. No problem — these things happen. I stayed on for ~10 minutes in case there was a late join.

To keep momentum, I've attached a short evidence checklist and a draft version of the questionnaire we planned to walk through. If you'd prefer, we can also do a 20–30 minute triage call to hand off items and collect the evidence asynchronously.

Proposed next steps (pick any):
- Option A: Thu Dec 10 — 10:00–10:30 AM PST
- Option B: Thu Dec 10 — 02:00–02:45 PM PST
- Option C: Fri Dec 11 — 08:30–09:00 AM PST

If none of those work, please send 2–3 windows that fit your team and I’ll coordinate. Also let me know which folks from your side should attend (security lead, infra owner, procurement).

Resources attached: SOC2-evidence-checklist.pdf (quick starter) and mednova-questionnaire-draft.xlsx (our annotated copy). I can also share a recording of today's empty room if that helps with scheduling notes.

Apologies if the calendar invite time zone caused confusion — we set the invite in PST when we created the meeting.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Senior Security Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2-evidence-checklist.pdf (PDF, 86KB)]
[Attachment: mednova-questionnaire-draft.xlsx (Spreadsheet, 120KB)]
